title: Prepare synthetic and wine data
description: You sample two-dimensional observations and prepare standardized datasets.

steps.description: You choose among three Gaussian components with probabilities 0.4, 0.4, and 0.2. Each component has its own mean and covariance matrix.
You sample each row from the Gaussian selected by its component index m. The function returns the observation array X.

steps.question: Does the call create the default 600 observations or a different count?
steps.answer: The explicit argument 700 overrides the default. X2 therefore has 700 rows and two columns.

steps.description: You standardize X2, then load and standardize the wine features separately. The final statement requests the dataset shapes and wine class count; the supplied recording contains no printed result.
